passages.text: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe gave it to the choirmaster.\r\nThe choirmaster should use the Sheminith style.

passages.text: Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
He wanted it played according to Sheminith.
David prayed to the LORD.
He said, "Help, O LORD."
He saw that the godly people were gone.
He saw that faithful people had disappeared from among men.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הוָה כִּי־ גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי־ פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He spoke about people in his time.
People lied to each other.
Each person spoke false words to his neighbor.
They used flattering lips.
They tried to please others with smooth words.
They spoke with a double heart.
Their words did not match their true thoughts.
They were not honest.
passages.original: שָׁ֤וְא׀ יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־ רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD has power over all people.
The LORD will cut off every person who speaks with flattering lips.
The LORD will remove every tongue that boasts proudly.
passages.original: יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃

passages.text: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”
passages.sermon:
Some people speak with pride and arrogance.
They trust in their own words.
They say, “We will win with our tongues.”
They claim, “Our lips belong to us.”
They ask, “Who can rule over us?”
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ׀ לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD sees the suffering of the oppressed.
The LORD hears the groaning of the needy.
The LORD says, "I will now arise."
The LORD promises to act.
The LORD will bring safety to the one who longs for help.
passages.original: מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks words.
The words of the LORD are pure.
The words of the LORD have no fault.
The words of the LORD are like silver.
People refine silver in a furnace on the earth.
The words of the LORD are like silver made pure seven times.
The words of the LORD are completely pure.
passages.original: אִֽמֲר֣וֹת יְהוָה֮ אֲמָר֪וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our protector.
The LORD keeps us safe.
The LORD guards us from this generation.
The LORD will do this forever.
passages.original: אַתָּֽה־ יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ׀ מִן־ הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.
passages.sermon:
The wicked walk all around.
They move freely everywhere.
People honor what is vile.
Men lift up what is shameful.
Evil is praised among people.
passages.original: סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
